Main frontend developer in my team at ComeOn and winner of the Make It Happen award (2026). I care about accessibility, multilingual UX and turning fuzzy client problems into clear, friendly interfaces.
skills: Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind, MUI
State & data: Zustand, Redux, TanStack Query, REST

about.title: Hi, I’m Bianca.
about.p1: Half Brazilian, half Italian, I moved to Europe to follow a dream, and I’m happy to call that dream my everyday life. I love exploring new places, getting lost in a good book, and sharing stories over a great conversation.
about.p2: Christmas holds a special place in my heart for its warmth, traditions, and the joy of bringing people together. Curious by nature, I’m always looking for something new to learn and meaningful connections along the way.
about.photoAlt: Bianca smiling in a grand baroque library full of old books
